summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue general obligation bonds, repaid by property taxes, to fund school facilities.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes the bonds and the associated property-tax levy to fund college facility projects.
tax.quote: If approved, Measure Y would levy $25 a year for every $100,000 of assessed property value and generate about $56 million annually while the bonds are outstanding.

schools.text: A Yes vote authorizes bonds to fund repairs, upgrades, equipment, and other projects at the two community colleges.
schools.quote: Measure Y would authorize bonds for San Bernardino Valley College and Crafton Hills College to repair and upgrade classrooms, labs, training spaces, infrastructure and equipment.

tax.text: A No vote does not authorize the bonds or the associated property-tax levy.
